info.name: List processing results for a given feed

params.name: bookmark
params.description: Cursor used to fetch the next page of items

params.name: page_size
params.description: Maximum number of items to include in a single page of the response. See documentation on Pagination for more information.

params.name: ad_account_id
params.description: Unique identifier of an ad account.

items.docs: Fetch a feed processing results owned by the "operation user_account". Please note that for now the bookmark parameter is not functional and only the first page will be available until it is implemented in some release in the near future. - By default, the "operation user_account" is the token user_account. info.name: List item issues for a given processing result

params.name: bookmark
params.description: Cursor used to fetch the next page of items

params.name: page_size
params.description: Maximum number of items to include in a single page of the response. See documentation on Pagination for more information.

params.name: processing_result_id
params.description: Unique identifier of a feed processing result. It can be acquired from the "id" field of the "items" array within the response of the [List processing results for a given feed](https://developers.pinterest.com/docs/api/v5/#operation/feed_processing_results/list).

params.name: item_numbers
params.description: Item number based on order of appearance in the Catalogs Feed. For example, '0' refers to first item found in a feed that was downloaded from a 'location' specified during feed creation.

params.name: item_validation_issue
params.description: Filter item validation issues that have a given type of item validation issue.

params.name: ad_account_id
params.description: Unique identifier of an ad account.

items.docs: List item validation issues for a given feed processing result owned by the "operation user_account". Up to 20 random samples of affected items are returned for each error and warning code. Please note that for now query parameters 'item_numbers' and 'item_validation_issue' cannot be used simultaneously until it is implemented in some release in the future. - By default, the "operation user_account" is the token user_account.
